nodes.title: SG-11.2.1 Subscribe BootScene.create to the transitionTo event
nodes.body:
Context: ReactToPhaserEvents already declares transitionTo { sceneId } in game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts and BootScene.create already subscribes to playAnimation, but nothing listens for transitionTo. Desired behavior: create() subscribes to transitionTo; the handler fades the main camera out and, when the fade completes, starts the scene named in the event. Expected result: emitting transitionTo from React changes the active Phaser scene after a fade. Why: part of SG-11 so the React UI can drive scene changes. Shutdown cleanup is the separate sub-goal SG-11.2.2.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create has run, when reactToPhaser emits transitionTo with { sceneId: 'library' }, then cameras.main.fadeOut is called once.
- Given the fade-out has been requested, when the camera fires its fade-out-complete event, then scene.start is called once with 'library'.
- Given the fade-out has not completed, when transitionTo is handled, then scene.start has not been called yet.


## Scope
- In scope: Subscribe to transitionTo in BootScene.create
- In scope: Fade the main camera out and start the target scene on completion
- Out of scope: Unsubscribing on SHUTDOWN (SG-11.2.2)
- Out of scope: Emitting transitionTo from App
- Out of scope: Defining new scenes or changing the event payload type
- Preserve: Existing playAnimation subscription and shutdown handling
- Preserve: Typed event bus API in events.ts
- Preserve: sceneReady emission


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only (cameras.main.fadeOut, Phaser.Cameras.Scene2D.Events.FADE_OUT_COMPLETE, scene.start)
- Use the existing reactToPhaser bus; no new dependencies


## Definition of done
- Handler subscribed in create() and behaves per the acceptance criteria
- Type-check passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene fades out and starts the scene named in transitionTo
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.create (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) has no transitionTo listener. Desired behavior: a listener registered in create() calls cameras.main.fadeOut and, once on FADE_OUT_COMPLETE, calls scene.start(sceneId). Expected result: React-driven transitions play a fade before the new scene begins. Why: smooth scene changes for SG-11.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given create() ran, when transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } is emitted, then cameras.main.fadeOut is called with a positive duration.
- Given the fade-out was requested, when FADE_OUT_COMPLETE fires, then scene.start is called with 'library' exactly once.
- Given no transitionTo was emitted, then fadeOut and scene.start are never called.


## Scope
- In scope: transitionTo handler in BootScene.create
- Out of scope: Shutdown unsubscribe
- Out of scope: App-side emission
- Preserve: playAnimation wiring
- Preserve: Keyboard and store subscriptions


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 camera fade API


## Definition of done
- Behavior matches the acceptance criteria


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Act: Subscribe BootScene.create to transitionTo with fade-out and scene start
nodes.body:
Add a private field holding the unsubscribe function and register the handler in create() next to the playAnimation subscription. The handler calls this.cameras.main.fadeOut(TRANSITION_FADE_MS) and registers a one-time listener for the camera fade-out-complete event that calls this.scene.start(sceneId).

## Acceptance criteria
- transitionTo emission calls cameras.main.fadeOut once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS.
- scene.start(sceneId) is called only after fade-out-complete fires.


## Scope
- In scope: BootScene.ts field, constant and subscription
- Out of scope: SHUTDOWN unsubscribe
- Preserve: Existing create() order and shutdown handler


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90
- Use reactToPhaser.on which returns an unsubscribe function
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts`


## Definition of done
- Subscription added in create()
- tsc --noEmit passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Verify: BootScene fades out and starts the scene on transitionTo unit tests
nodes.body:
Write a new unit test file with a fake Phaser (modeled on game/frontend/tests/bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts) whose cameras.main exposes fadeOut and once spies, whose scene exposes start, and which provides Cameras.Scene2D.Events.FADE_OUT_COMPLETE = 'camerafadeoutcomplete'. No browser or real Phaser is used.

## Acceptance criteria
- fadeOut is called once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS after transitionTo is emitted.
- scene.start is not called before the fade-out-complete callback runs and is called once with the sceneId afterwards.
- Nothing is called when transitionTo was not emitted.


## Scope
- In scope: New test file bootSceneTransition.test.ts
- Out of scope: Shutdown unsubscribe tests
- Preserve: Existing BootScene tests


## Technical constraints
- Vitest; Phaser fully mocked; content module mocked as in bootScenePlayAnimation.test.ts


## Definition of done
- Tests pass in seconds using only the named file


## Clarifying questions
- None
